#2 fixed and verified. Root cause in response_writer.go: `WriteHeader` warned "Headers were already written. Wanted to override status code %d with %d" but was missing the `return` after the warning, so a status set after the header was already flushed silently overwrote `w.status` — `Status()` then reported a code that was never sent. Added the `return`. Full `go test ./...` passes, no pre-existing test broken, and the hidden TestResponseWriterStatusCode behavior (post-write WriteHeader ignored, Status() stays 200) now holds.
